mapping_diagnosis.distinguishing_reason: Node n1 (入口条件核对) is clearly embodied as a distinct step with explicit verification actions. Node n2 (结果验收记录) is present but its role as a process (物质的变化) is weakly realized—it appears only as a final check, not as a transformation or change. Edge e1 (enables) is supported by the story's comparison of records, but the direction (n1 enables n2) is not explicitly shown as a causal or enabling sequence; the story shows n1 and n2 as parallel checks rather than n1 enabling n2. This makes the mapping less precise than a direct sequential realization.
